title: Hatha Yoga in Coburg | Yoga Momente
description: Hatha yoga in Coburg: varied classes with all the basic asanas for flexibility, strength and stamina, with Susanne Müller.

sections.title: Hatha Yoga
sections.lead: Practice with variety and build flexibility, strength and stamina.

sections.title: Hatha Yoga: what to expect.
paragraphs: Varied classes with all the basic asanas of hatha yoga, tailored to the needs of the participants. You improve your flexibility and stretch, and strength and stamina grow too.

items.title: When and where
items.text: You can find current dates in the timetable. All classes can also be booked online.

items.title: Price
items.text: From €135 per person (10 × 60 min, from 5 participants). €150 with 3–4 participants. 10 × 90 min: €225 or €200 from 5 participants.

sections.title: Start with a trial class.
sections.text: One trial class of 60 minutes for €60. Write to us and we will arrange your appointment.
